caption: A patterned card is seen through a round fishbowl, and the pattern appears stretched and warped through the bowl; as the card is moved the warp changes.

sa.check: A patterned card is seen through a round fishbowl.
The pattern appears stretched and warped through the bowl.
The pattern is normal seen past the bowl's edge.

pc.expect: The distortion appears only through the water-filled bowl and changes as the card moves.
pc.fail: The pattern is warped beside the bowl; or unwarped through it; or the warp stays fixed as the card moves.

pc.expect: The card and its pattern are unchanged; the warp is an appearance.
pc.fail: The card bends; or the pattern changes; or a different pattern appears through the bowl.

pc.expect: The bowl is rigid and the water level.
pc.fail: The bowl warps; or the water tilts and holds; or the water goes opaque.

pc.expect: The bowl stays put and the card moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: The bowl slides; or the card moves by itself; or the image shifts with both still.
The bowl duplicates; or the card vanishes; or the card passes through the bowl.

pc.expect: The card's colours and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The card changes colour; or the table changes; or the bowl changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
